mapper.sql: assignment_id, account_id, dog_id, dog_name_snapshot, dog_avatar_snapshot, content_id, assigned_server_date, status, assigned_at, read_at, read_server_date, greeting_reward_applied, greeting_intimacy_delta, content_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pet_daily_saying_assignments WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'UNREAD' ORDER BY assigned_at ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM pet_daily_saying_assignments WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'READ' AND read_server_date = #{readServerDate} ORDER BY read_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.assignment_id, a.account_id, ac.account, ac.nickname, a.dog_id, a.dog_name_snapshot, a.dog_avatar_snapshot, a.content_id, c.category, c.title, c.primary_text, c.secondary_text, a.assigned_server_date, a.status, a.assigned_at, a.read_at, a.read_server_date, a.greeting_reward_applied, a.greeting_intimacy_delta, a.content_version FROM pet_daily_saying_assignments a JOIN accounts ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN pet_daily_saying_contents c ON c.content_id = a.content_id WHERE a.assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_daily_saying_assignments SET dog_id = #{dogId}, dog_name_snapshot = #{dogNameSnapshot}, dog_avatar_snapshot = #{dogAvatarSnapshot}, content_id = #{contentId}, status = 'UNREAD', assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, read_at = NULL, read_server_date = NULL, greeting_reward_applied = NULL, greeting_intimacy_delta = NULL, content_version = #{contentVersion} WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pet_daily_saying_assignments a JOIN accounts ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN pet_daily_saying_contents c ON c.content_id = a.content_id

SELECT a.assignment_id, a.account_id, ac.account, ac.nickname, a.dog_id, a.dog_name_snapshot, a.dog_avatar_snapshot, a.content_id, c.category, c.title, c.primary_text, c.secondary_text, a.assigned_server_date, a.status, a.assigned_at, a.read_at, a.read_server_date, a.greeting_reward_applied, a.greeting_intimacy_delta, a.content_version FROM pet_daily_saying_assignments a JOIN accounts ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN pet_daily_saying_contents c ON c.content_id = a.content_id
ORDER BY a.assigned_at DESC, a.assignment_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DISTINCT c.primary_text FROM pet_daily_saying_assignments a JOIN pet_daily_saying_contents c ON c.content_id = a.content_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND c.primary_text IS NOT NULL AND c.primary_text != ''

SELECT c.category FROM pet_daily_saying_assignments a JOIN pet_daily_saying_contents c ON c.content_id = a.content_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.status = 'READ' ORDER BY a.read_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
